context RepairService::approve(sid: Integer, rid: Integer, reject: Boolean, suggestion: String): ApprovalHistory

pre RepairExists:
    Repair.allInstances()->exists(r | r.Id = rid)

pre StaffExists:
    Staff.allInstances()->exists(s | s.Id = sid)

post NewApprovalHistoryCreated:
    ApprovalHistory.allInstances()->exists(ah |
        not ApprovalHistory.allInstances@pre()->includes(ah) and
        ah.StaffId = sid and
        ah.Reject = reject and
        ah.Suggestion = suggestion
    )

post NewApprovalHistoryLinkedToRepair:
    Repair.allInstances()->any(r | r.Id = rid).History->exists(ah |
        not ApprovalHistory.allInstances@pre()->includes(ah) and
        ah.StaffId = sid and
        ah.Reject = reject and

        else

    let u: User = User.allInstances()->any(u | u.UserID = uid) in

        c.Status = CopyStatus::AVAILABLE or
        (
            c.Status = CopyStatus::ONHOLDSHELF and
            c.IsReserved = true and

                r.IsReserveClosed = false
            )

    let u: User = User.allInstances()->any(u | u.UserID = uid) in
    let c: BookCopy = BookCopy.allInstances()->any(c | c.Barcode = barcode) in
        Loan.allInstances()->exists(l |

            l.LoanedCopy = c and
            l.LoanDate = Date::today() and
            l.ReturnDate.oclIsUndefined()
        )

    let u: User = User.allInstances()->any(u | u.UserID = uid) in
    let c: BookCopy = BookCopy.allInstances()->any(c | c.Barcode = barcode) in
    let l: Loan = Loan.allInstances()->any(l |
        l.oclIsNew() and l.Borrower = u and l.LoanedCopy = c
    ) in
        if u.oclIsKindOf(Student) then
            l.DueDate = Date::today().addDays(30)
        else
            if u.oclIsKindOf(Faculty) then
                l.DueDate = Date::today().addDays(60)
            else
                false
            endif
        endif

post LoanCountIncreased:
    let u: User = User.allInstances()->any(u | u.UserID = uid) in
        u.LoanedNumber = u.LoanedNumber@pre + 1

post CopyMarkedLoaned:
    let c: BookCopy = BookCopy.allInstances()->any(c | c.Barcode = barcode) in
        c.Status = CopyStatus::LOANED

post OverdueFlagsInitialized:
    let u: User = User.allInstances()->any(u | u.UserID = uid) in
    let c: BookCopy = BookCopy.allInstances()->any(c | c.Barcode = barcode) in
    let l: Loan = Loan.allInstances()->any(l |

    ) in

        l.IsOverdue10Days = false and
        l.IsOverdue17Days = false and
        l.IsOverdue31Days = false

    let u: User = User.allInstances()->any(u | u.UserID = uid) in
    let c: BookCopy = BookCopy.allInstances()->any(c | c.Barcode = barcode) in
        if c.Status@pre = CopyStatus::ONHOLDSHELF then

                r.IsReserveClosed@pre = false
            )->forAll(r | r.IsReserveClosed = true)
        else
            true
        endif

post ResultIsTrue:
    result = true
